articles.title: Kalshi argues its election predictions are a public service in bid to ward off regulators
articles.summary: Kalshi is pushing back against regulators by framing its election prediction market as a civic good rather than a gambling product. If that argument sticks, it could reshape how the entire prediction markets industry defends itself against the CFTC's skepticism.

articles.title: Kyle Whittingham Coach Fired Market Trending Up on Kalshi Amidst Disastrous Michigan Season
articles.summary: Kyle Whittingham's job security at Utah is suddenly looking precarious as the Utes stumble through a disastrous season, with Kalshi traders now pricing in a meaningful probability he gets fired. This kind of real-time shift in coaching market odds reveals how fast public perception swings when results go south, and smart bettors who got ahead of the narrative earlier are likely cashing out right now.

articles.title: GPAHE Report Targets Kalshi, Polymarket Creator Sponsorships
articles.summary: A congressional report is calling out Kalshi and Polymarket for accepting sponsorships from their creators, raising questions about conflicts of interest in how these platforms operate. If regulators take this seriously, it could force prediction market platforms to restructure their funding models or face tighter restrictions on who can bankroll them.

articles.title: Kalshi Sign Up Bonus Activates $55 for NBA Cup Today Using Code ACTION55
articles.summary: Kalshi's dropping a $55 sign-up bonus for NBA Cup today with code ACTION55, which means they're aggressively courting new users during peak basketball season. Free capital + prediction markets on major sports events = the kind of user acquisition move that matters when you're fighting for market share in a still-nascent category.

articles.title: Coinbase looking to offer its own U.S. prediction markets in first half of 2027
articles.summary: Coinbase is building its own prediction markets platform and plans to launch it in the U.S. during the first half of 2027. If a major crypto exchange actually ships this, it could legitimize prediction markets for retail users who already trust Coinbase with their assets, potentially pulling billions from offshore operators like Polymarket.

articles.title: NY Mayor Warns Prediction Markets Fuel Gambling Addiction
articles.summary: NYC Mayor Eric Adams is apparently worried that prediction markets are turning America into a nation of degenerate gamblers, which is rich coming from a guy running a city that literally prints money off lottery tickets. If regulators start parroting this line, we're looking at real friction for platforms operating in the Northeast, the densest market in the country.

articles.title: Polymarket code “SILIVE” unlocks $25 referral promo for Thursday Night Football
articles.summary: Polymarket is running a $25 referral bonus for new users who sign up with code "SILIVE" ahead of Thursday Night Football. The promo signals aggressive customer acquisition spending as prediction markets compete harder for retail volume during major sports events.

articles.title: Mamdani: Betting markets ‘degrade so much of life’
articles.summary: Mahmood Mamdani, a prominent public intellectual, is arguing that betting markets commodify and cheapen fundamental aspects of human experience. The critique matters because it's exactly the kind moral skepticism that could actually move regulators and shape how prediction markets get positioned as they expand into mainstream finance.

articles.title: Michigan Forced Polymarket to Retreat. Did the State Expose Prediction Markets' Weak Spot?
articles.summary: Michigan's regulators forced Polymarket to block residents from using their platform, testing whether states can weaponize gambling laws to crush prediction markets before they go mainstream. If other states follow suit, we're looking at a patchwork of regional bans that could balkanize the entire industry before it ever gets legitimacy.

articles.title: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Prediction Markets: Ezra Frech Favorite for Finale
articles.summary: Ezra Frech, the Paralympic athlete turned reality TV competitor, is the betting favorite to win this season of Dancing With the Stars. His odds advantage suggests the market's pricing in both his athletic coordination and the sympathy bias that typically propels athlete contestants toward finale appearances.

articles.title: Kalshi Asks States for Help in Restricting Problem Gamblers
articles.summary: Kalshi's lobbying states to implement tighter restrictions on problem gamblers, essentially asking regulators to do the heavy lifting on consumer protection so the platform doesn't have to. If states actually follow through, prediction market operators face higher compliance costs and a smaller addressable market, but also get to point at "responsible gambling" measures when regulators come knocking.

articles.title: Are Prediction Markets the Future of Finance?
articles.summary: Prediction markets are getting pitched as the next big thing in financial infrastructure, with backers claiming they'll eventually replace traditional forecasting methods. If true, that means serious money flows into volume and liquidity for the platforms that nail user experience and regulatory compliance first.
